brief: A modern, high-performance automated YouTube video uploader built with Selenium, featuring a real-time web command console, priority queue scheduling, multi-channel profile persistence, and auto-retry pipeline. Replaced the generic YouTube play button with an ownable, engineering-grade identifier.
criteria: Success: immediate brand recognition (Y + U), distinct from passive YouTube play triangles, flawless 16px reproduction, robust one-color mode, and seamless integration with the dark-themed command console.

concepts.name: Kinetic YU
concepts.idea: Monolithic monogram merging Y (YouTube) + U (Uploader/Queue Tray) with an ascending velocity rocket.
rationale: Embeds the brand initials (Y+U) directly in an iconic silhouette
Replaces passive video viewing with active upward momentum
Achieves 100/100 production score with exact 45° precision cuts
Tested down to 16px favicon with zero loss of silhouette clarity

concepts.name: Velocity Shutter
concepts.idea: Precision octagonal studio lens aperture cycling continuously into an ascending playhead beacon.
rationale: Evokes camera optics and continuous cyclic automation
Reflects the cyber-editorial aesthetic of the command console

concepts.name: Studio Launchpad
concepts.idea: The YouTube video monitor frame transformed into a launch silo with a breakthrough rocket playhead.
rationale: Draws upon recognizable screen equity with an explosive upward twist
Dual queue process wafers narrate the batch upload lifecycle

recommendation: Kinetic YU — the most ownable, punchy, and scalable mark that instantly identifies the software across desktop, mobile, CLI terminal, and browser tab.
next_steps: Production master files generated (flat, dark, light, stacked, mono, app-icon, favicon)
Dashboard interface integrated with the new brand mark
Brand guidelines and asset kit packaged
